items.hook: Youth Without Youth is a 1976 novella by Romanian author Mircea Eliade.
items.body: It follows the life of Dominic Matei, an elderly Romanian intellectual who experiences a cataclysmic event that allows him to live a new life with startling intellectual capacity. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: The V-STOL Solution is an American ultralight aircraft that was designed by Dick Turner in 1998 and produced by V-STOL Aircraft.
items.body: The aircraft was supplied as a kit for amateur construction. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Obama Identity: A Novel is a 2010 novel written by Edward Klein and former Republican United States Representative John LeBoutillier.
items.body: Among other things, the book explores and promotes the Barack Obama citizenship conspiracy theories and Barack Obama religion conspiracy theories in the form of a novel. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Shining Darkness is a BBC Books original novel written by Mark Michalowski and based on the long-running science fiction television series Doctor Who.
items.body: It features the Tenth Doctor and Donna Noble. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
